items.headline: Permit issued for two ADUs on one North San Jose lot
items.summary: A single permit at 247 N 34th St covers two detached accessory dwelling units valued at $135,272, more than the typical one-ADU permits issued elsewhere this week.

items.headline: All new-home permits this week are ADUs, not full houses
items.summary: Every 'new home' permit issued in this batch—eight in total—is for an accessory dwelling unit (attached or detached) rather than a standalone house, reflecting how much of San Jose's small-scale housing growth is now happening via ADUs on existing lots.

items.headline: Council to discuss three lawsuits against Cupertino in closed session
items.summary: The City Council is scheduled to meet in closed session with legal counsel on existing litigation, including cases brought by Lixin (Leon) Chen and others, Yes in My Backyard, and the Garden Gate Coalition for Mary Avenue Safety, all filed against the City of Cupertino in Santa Clara County Superior Court.

items.headline: Sunnyvale considers permit for nearly 9-foot fence
items.summary: The Planning Commission is scheduled to consider a use permit for an 8-foot-9¾-inch fence in the front yard of a single-family home at 1617 Edmonton Avenue, well above the standard 6-foot limit.
